item.title: SLIPKNOT’s COREY TAYLOR Explains Why He Keeps Returning to a 1970 BLACK SABBATH Track That Still Terrifies Him
item.description: Slipknot frontman Corey Taylor still remembers the chill he got the first time he heard Black Sabbath, the song, not just the band. In a recent interview with the BBC, Taylor shared how deeply the track affected him.

item.title: AARON STAINTHORPE Talks Leaving MY DYING BRIDE: 'I Feel 10 Years Younger'
item.description: Aaron Stainthorpe, known for fronting British metal band My Dying Bride for over three decades, says his new project has given him a fresh perspective, and a second wind.

item.title: Ghost Reveals Papa V Perpetua as New Frontman for 2025 World Tour–Everything We Know So Far
item.description: Ah yes. Another day, another Papa. GHOST is back at it again boys, unveiling yet another masked frontman, I mean, why have just one identity when you can cycle through a whole liturgy of them?
